The fact that DROPPING ℓ=2 (rather than including it) gives the best Q_β prediction CONFIRMS the cyFlQ insight: Q_β is the S-even projection of (m_n - m_p - m_e), so the S-odd chirality contribution should NOT be included. This is direct empirical support for the S-eigenvalue framework as the correct organising principle.
